issues.title: Autoresponder email not sent to leads
issues.problem_statement: Leads were coming in from the customer's form, but the autoresponder email was not going out to them.

issues.title: Emails possibly landing in spam
issues.problem_statement: Support advised that emails can sometimes land in spam and that verifying the sender domain is a good idea; the customer did not report a spam problem.

items.description: Customer turned on the autoresponder option in the form settings and saved it, following support's guidance; after submitting a test form from a second email the customer confirmed the email arrived and everything now works.
evidence: भर दिया... हाँ, ईमेल आ गया! अब सही चल रहा है।
